subject: dym-spt
title: DYM.SPT.------AFI.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-37, on the page where Braxton names the use of creativity as 'one of the most sacred alliances we can enter into' and warns that 'if not understood, that culture (and person) could possibly expose themselves to cosmic actualities (and matters) that could cause serious harm.' (C)DYM-SPT — the *concept* of dynamic spiritualism — is crossed with AFI (affinity insight). The diagram contains both AFI(1) (the affirmation/transformation principle) and AFI(2) (the celebration/composite-knowingness principle) as separate nodes — the only diagram in this section to make the AFI bifurcation diagrammatic. SOC-RT (social reality), AFI-2, and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) feed the subject. SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) feeds PART (participation), a side branch. The subject outputs to COS-D (cosmic dictates) → ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics), and to RT-DY (reality dynamics). AFI itself outputs to AFI-1 and to TR (transformation). Structural argument: dynamic spiritualism crossed with affinity insight is the diagram for how creativity's sacred-alliance dimension actually operates — with AFI(2) (celebration) feeding the spiritualism subject from the social-reality side, and AFI proper splitting into AFI(1) and direct transformation as parallel outputs. Cosmic dictates produces accelerated dynamics. The diagram thus diagrams the *responsibility structure* Braxton has just argued for: dynamic spiritualism's outputs into reality dynamics and (via cosmic dictates) into accelerated dynamics are exactly what carry the 'serious harm' potential if undertaken without affinity-insight grounding.
